title_zh: 让家族展览说明有材料可查

scenario.label_zh: 修订家族移民经历展览说明
scenario.goal_zh: 核对人物经历与历史材料，限定有证据支持的影响描述并安排补充出处

context_zh: 学生萝丝和展览指导老师准备一份虚构的家族历史展示。
author: author-phase05-c

sentences.speaker: Rose
sentences.text: My grandmother was an immigrant. She arrived here at nineteen and later worked for the town council.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chen
sentences.text: What evidence do you have for the dates in your display?

sentences.speaker: Rose
sentences.text: These historical documents include her arrival record and a letter offering her the council job.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chen
sentences.text: Your next caption says she changed the whole town. Can you show how?

sentences.speaker: Rose
sentences.text: She helped with the first election in which women here could vote. The museum describes it as a historic election.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chen
sentences.text: That establishes why the election mattered, but not how much your grandmother shaped it.

sentences.speaker: Rose
sentences.text: Then I should not say she had a major influence on the result. The letter only says she helped people register.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chen
sentences.text: Exactly. Describe that work and name the source beside the caption.

sentences.speaker: Rose
sentences.text: I will replace the broad claim with her documented role and add references to the letter and museum record.
